plants.name: Paeonia lactiflora
plants.description: Plush, bowl-shaped blooms open from fat round buds, with ruffled petals around golden stamens. Many are sweetly fragrant. The flowers sit above glossy, deeply cut leaves and fill borders with soft color for a few lavish weeks.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid to late spring, with May as the peak bloom month in temperate Northern Hemisphere gardens
plants.location: Temperate gardens across North America and Europe, and native to Siberia, China and Tibet
plants.funFact: Peonies are long-lived perennials. A well-sited clump can bloom for decades, and the stems die back to the ground after frost each year before sprouting again in spring.

plants.name: Rhododendron arboreum
plants.description: Entire hillsides in the high Himalaya glow with clusters of bell-shaped blooms that hang from tall, gnarled trees. The red, pink and white flowers light up the mountain forests as spring reaches the higher slopes.
plants.bloomingSeason: Spring, from March into May. Blooms come later at higher elevations.
plants.funFact: Rhododendron is Nepal's national flower, and locals call it lali guras.
